test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

About three years ago, an old man, ______ name was Paul, used to live in this house.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Whose**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Whose: "****Whose"** is a possessive pronoun. We use it when **asking or telling** to **whom something or someone belongs**__.
